prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: monochrome hand silhouette alpha mask for a speedcubing timer, used up to 400pt at 3x scale
Input image: EDIT TARGET is the existing flat left-hand silhouette. Its thumb points to the right and four upright spread fingers fan left.
Primary request: redraw and clean this hand silhouette's damaged outline. Preserve the pose, proportions, finger arrangement, left-hand orientation, slightly tilted middle/ring fingers, rounded fingertips and rounded palm bottom. Make the hand a single connected, flat solid WHITE silhouette with exactly five digits: four long fingers and one right-side thumb. Fingers separated by clear smoothly rounded U-shaped gaps; gently smooth contour at every fingertip and between fingers. Eliminate the noisy white extraction halo, all stray pixels and all edge fragments of the previous rectangular background. Preserve the original minimal pictogram style, not 3D or realistic skin.
Composition: same portrait proportions as reference, one centered hand, maximum visible dimension approximately 88% of canvas, transparent padding fully clear on all four sides. Full silhouette must be visible. High resolution clean vector-like curves and smoothly antialiased alpha suitable for large retina rendering.
Color and alpha: solid uniform white interior; smooth clean antialiased transparent edges. Gaps between fingers and entire background MUST have genuine zero alpha. No background, no rectangle, no outline, no stroke, no glow, no halo, no shadows, no texture, no nails, no interior palm lines, no wrist extension, no labels or text. Do not add anything else. Single hand only.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: clean alpha-mask hand icon for a speedcubing timer app
Generate a NEW clean simple flat hand silhouette from scratch, NOT a photograph and NOT 3D. A single open LEFT hand viewed palm-on, fingers pointing upwards, thumb on the RIGHT. Exactly FIVE digits: small pinky at far left, taller ring finger angled slightly left, tallest middle finger angled slightly left, upright index finger, diagonal thumb at right. Four finger gaps with smoothly rounded bottoms. Palm broad with soft rounded lower contour, no extended wrist. Slightly organic and friendly proportions, close to a classic minimal handprint pictogram.
CRITICAL: one continuous clean shape made of uniform solid WHITE, like a carefully designed vector path rasterized at high resolution. Shape must have mathematically smooth rounded contours, smooth fingertips, smoothly antialiased alpha edges. Every finger gap must be completely empty and clean. Background must be genuinely transparent with ALPHA ZERO. Only a 1-pixel antialias transition along the intended contour. Absolutely no stray pixels, ragged debris, missing chunks, glows, white fringe, outlines, distressed edges, brush effects, texture or noise.
Composition: portrait canvas around 11:12, silhouette occupying about 86% of canvas width and height, fully visible, centered with clear padding on every side. Suitable for up to 400pt retina app display. No nails, no skin details, no interior lines, no text, no shadows, no background or frames. Single smooth white silhouette only.
